verdict.rationale: Ente states that its apps and server are open source (llms.txt), and a community member thanks the team for releasing Auth as open source. The docs also link to the public ente/ente GitHub monorepo, so the code handling seeds can be inspected. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the client app source repositories and license, and evidence of community or independent security review or audits of the seed-handling code.
